draft.how_matches_were_made: Matched on shared words. Each sentence is lowercased, stripped of its LaTeX and of the everyday words the whole book uses, and what is left is reduced to a rough stem so 'fractions' and 'fraction' count as one word. A total of 1.0 or more is a match. Every match lists the words that produced it.
